# Wildflower Retreats

> Small-group slow travel weeks on the Black Sea coast of Georgia. A design and engineering portfolio demo site showcasing modern slow travel retreat experiences in Batumi.

## Overview
- [Home](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/#hero): Main landing page with full-bleed dual-layer interactive landscape
- [The Retreat](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/#camp): Concept, small-group philosophy, local hosts, and accommodation
- [The Week](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/#offer): 7-day slow travel program, botanical garden, mountain canyons, and supra dinners
- [Dates & Booking](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/#shifts): Weekly retreat dates, package pricing, and availability
- [Contact](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/#contacts): Interactive inquiry form and direct messaging
- [Privacy Policy](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/rules): Demo privacy policy and data protection terms

## Optional
- [Sitemap](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap listing canonical routes
